SELECT , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM article_tags at2 JOIN tags t ON t.id = at2.tag_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE at2.article_id = a.id) AS tag_names FROM articles a LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.status = 1
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND a.status = #{status}
AND a.id IN ( SELECT at3.article_id FROM article_tags at3 WHERE at3.tag_id = #{tagId} )
ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.create_time DESC
